title: Introducing Hibiscus StudyPal
body: AI is the future; and that is why we at Hibiscus School have introduced StudyPal. StudyPal is our very own AI-powered home study platform, designed to extend learning beyond the classroom. Our students can access an AI tutor at any time, generate their own quizzes, use smart revision tools, and stay connected with school updates; all from one platform. As educators, we are now able to monitor every student's study activity from home in real time; giving our teachers deeper insight and keeping every learner accountable. At Hibiscus, we are not just keeping up with the future; we are preparing our students for it. This is Hibiscus StudyPal.
